title: Saved interfaces across accepted workflow revisions
summary: Current installed workspace reuses the immutable saved UI across a compatible source revision without compiler/model, supplies exact current context, preserves reopening/common fallback, and contains a required binding change with an explicit unavailable focused-update path. No execution, decision or old authority transfer.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace, click Workflows, Workflow files, Open workflow, select ui-evidence-negative-001.workflow.wflow and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Saved baseline
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved UI for the retained run; inspect its pending review without approving it.

manualSteps.label: Compatible change
manualSteps.instruction: After a conditional source revision that preserves bindings, open the saved UI for the new revision as a preparation view. Reopen it and use the common working view; neither should attach the old run.

manualSteps.label: Required binding change
manualSteps.instruction: After the fixture conditionally renames the bound output, open its saved UI for the new revision. It should explain the incompatible binding and offer the common view.

manualSteps.label: Update and fallback
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface. Inspect the existing saved interface and disabled Update selected interface control with the explicit missing compiler/model reason. Use the common view; restore the owned source conditionally.
